// Fixed types for task (d). Do not edit; check.sh uses its own copy.
import type { ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";

/** The greeter's own slice of the settings. */
export type GreetingSettings = { readonly locale: string };
export type GreeterDeps = { readonly settings: ReadonlyStore<GreetingSettings> };
export type GreeterPort = { readonly greet: (name: string) => string };
export declare function createGreeter(locale: string): GreeterPort;

export type GreeterProduct = { readonly instance: undefined; readonly capabilities: { readonly "acme/greeter": GreeterPort } };
